name: V140 attack-tail coupling sustain challenger
purpose: Model the relationship between repeated attack energy and later sustain-tail behavior without using any held-out V136D, V137, V138, or V139 carrier outcomes or professional/midterm answers.
designBasis: pre-midterm chord/sustain diagnostics treated repeated chord attacks and sustained ringing as separate requirements
V136 used within-band decay products, V138 used cross-band decay products, and V139 used decay persistence deltas; V140 changes family to attack-to-tail coupling
all source columns are drawn from the frozen spectro-temporal feature set
